portInfo.description: Ketchikan is a cruise call—confirm your berth on the daily programme before you plan the day.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Port of Ketchikan — Berth I — Downtown waterfront, Ketchikan, AK (Port office contact 334 Front Street)
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Downtown. Waterfront berths place passengers into the commercial core; measured walk minutes to Creek Street Not verified. Tours. Floatplane and coach pickups concentrate near the berths on busy days — follow city vendor-zone rules when published.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Misty Fjords / flightseeing — long call + weather only.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: On peak days all four berths may be occupied — confirm your berth number on the city’s assignment sheet before meeting a tour.
